_schema.purpose: Site version stamp. Placeholder skeleton; the release stamp script overwrites version/commit/date when a vX.Y.Z tag is cut, and keeps the static no-JS footer fallback in sync. No build step -- this file ships verbatim with the recipe folder.

fields.version: Released semver WITHOUT a leading 'v' (e.g. '0.1.0'). site-version.js prepends 'v' for display and the releases-tag URL. '0.0.0-dev' marks the unstamped placeholder.
fields.commit: Short commit SHA the tag points at (e.g. '0000000'). Informational; not currently rendered, reserved for a tooltip/title.
fields.date: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the version was stamped. Informational; reserved for a tooltip/title.

rules: Consumers MUST skip every '_'-prefixed key (this _schema block).
version is bare semver -- the 'v' prefix is added by the renderer, never stored here.
Stamp script is the only writer; do not hand-edit released values.
Same-origin local file only; no external request.
